programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes more than just a fight for survival; it's a terrifying examination of the fragility of peace and the price of freedom in a convoluted world.

programme.title: Eastmans' Journal Podcast
programme.desc:
Ike Eastman sits down with Mark Drury for a deep dive into a lifetime in the hunting industry—where it started, how it evolved, and what still drives the fire today. From growing up in the timber along the Mississippi River to building one of the most recognized brands in hunting media, Mark shares the real story behind the success, the struggles, and the relentless pursuit of getting better.
This episode goes beyond tactics. It’s about family, mentorship, and the responsibility of passing hunting on to the next generation. Mark breaks down the mindset behind DeerCast, how they built it, and why understanding “why animals move” matters more than ever. They also get into turkey season grind, evolving with media, and what it means to live a life in the outdoors.
If you care about hunting, legacy, and doing it the right way—this one hits.
(And yeah… those three questions get answered.)

programme.desc: In the final part of this two-hour special, the five remaining contestants learn that they're no longer competing as teams, but as individuals.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Censored
programme.desc: Twelve chefs and restaurateurs compete to impress Gordon Ramsay as he works to open a world-class restaurant in Los Angeles and discover the country's next culinary star.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Censored
programme.desc: After barely surviving the opening night of the Hell's Kitchen restaurant, the contestants prepare for their second dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Censored
programme.desc: The budding chefs prepare for their third dinner service, but the pressure of Hell's Kitchen is too much for one contestant.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Swarmed
programme.desc: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Fade To Black [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

programme.title: Living Dark: The Story of Ted the Caver
programme.desc: Two estranged brothers become obsessed with gaining access to an unexplored cave, despite the horrors they encounter during their excavation.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students heads into the rainforest to look for cave drawings. Instead, they find a 50-foot boa constrictor.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Hell Night
programme.desc: Four college pledges are forced to spend the night in a deserted old mansion, where they are stalked by the monstrous survivor of a family massacre years earlier.

programme.title: Body Bags [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A creepy-looking coroner (John Carpenter) introduces three different horror tales involving his current work which are cadavers in "body bags."

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation
programme.desc: A police detective (Joseph Bologna) teams up with a Cajun hunter (Richard Lynch) to find a giant killer-reptile in the city sewers.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage has a rather unique resident who is renowned as nature's lumberjack and North Americas largest rodent, the beaver. With their powerful teeth the trees they fell can be huge and their dams can be so enormous they can be seen from space. But since humans arrived here, many beavers have been forced to live in an urban jungle! And as the Wild City of Anchorage expands, that means more people, more cars, and the biggest risk to the beavers, dogs!

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Alaska one of the last true wildernesses on earth. With 600 square miles of pristine habitat this state is home to an abundance of wildlife. Herds of caribou roam the plains, wolves stalk in the forest and the brown bears are the kings of the rivers. But you don't always have to head to the wild to come face to face with an animal. In the city of Anchorage the wildlife is a lot closer than you think, because a city with so much green space means everywhere is fair game for its wild neighbours.

programme.title: Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale
programme.desc: Under a blanket of stars on an African night, in the serene grasslands of Botswana's Okavango Delta, something rarely witnessed by humankind is about to happen: the much-anticipated birth of a baby elephant. An emotional life-or-death drama that champions the struggle of Africa's native elephant population, Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale tells the urgent story of an international crisis.

programme.title: Coasts - Life's a Beach
programme.desc: To us the beach is one giant playground, but for wildlife it's a place to live, to find food and to raise their young. Amongst the fish and chips, sandcastles and donkey rides it's easy to forget that beaches are vital habitats, home to a myriad of animals. Whether grey seals are duelling for a mate and raising their young, or black bears and tigers are scouring the coastline for a tasty snack, animals have been using the beach for millennia.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Mammal Takeover
programme.desc: With the dinosaurs' passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Large areas of water, broken up by small islands. Massive vegetation. Swamps, wetlands, marshes, bogs and fens are found all over the world, generally in more temperate regions where there is fast vegetation growth. Many of the larger animals that inhabit swamps and wetlands have a fish-based diet. LARGE CRABS dwell in the salt-water swamps, along with SNAPPING TURTLES and even CROCODILES AND ALLIGATORS. LIZARDS AND AMPHIBIANS live in and around the water's edge.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Deserts - dry, arid landscapes, environments of intense sun, heat and very little rain. The desert is extreme. An extre-me climate and an extreme environment where wild life has had to adapt to survive. Many of the animals that live in deserts have adopted a nocturnal lifestyle, surfacing only at night when it is cooler.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The masters of the sky are the winged predators of the aerial world. Whether swooping from altitude at phenomenal speed to strike an unsuspecting target from above, flicking and darting between trees in a lethal tail chase, or ghos-ting silently through the night in pursuit of prey, they excite our admiration and inspire awe in equal measure. All are superbly adapted to hunting and masters of their position at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Lakes and rivers are created by streams high in the mountains. Fresh water springs, rain drawn up as moisture from the oceans, and melting snow all ebb, rush and flow down into our rivers and streams. Streams, rivers and lakes are home to countless animal species. A wide variety of species from insects, to amphibians, repti-les, fish, birds and even mammals are found in rivers, lakes and streams all around the world.

programme.title: Mountains - Gateways to Heaven
programme.desc: Mountains define our most spectacular landscapes. As they climb the changing altitude results in a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. They're found on every continent on Earth, literally from pole to pole, covering 22% of the planet's surface. An incredibly important part of our ecosystem, a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species, live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: Whether by wing, fin or hoof, epic migrations are among nature's most awe-inspiring events. Animals undertake these arduous journeys, for many reasons: to find a mate, to give birth, or to move to new feeding grounds. And danger lurks at every turn. In this episode we discover the lengths they go to in order to survive.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: Ever wondered how to look after dozens of tiny turtles? This episode of An Aquatic Life will show you just that! Meet the turtle team and their amazing ambassadors, Bob, Sandy and the monstrous loggerhead, Yoshi! The collections team is running at half capacity while most of the team members collect Ragged-Toothed Sharks in East London for the upcoming predator exhibit... But with a colossal storm en route to the city of Cape Town, will it all be ready for their arrival?

programme.title: Meet the Meerkats
programme.desc: Meerkats live in close families and rely on their companions to watch their backs. In their vast and unforgiving home of the Namib desert, only together can they defeat the odds stacked against them. One young female is forced from her group, overcoming a brutal attack from the alpha pair and fearing for her life. Cast out and left to fend for herself, she has no choice but to roam the desert and find a way to live.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Rise of the Giants
programme.desc: In the great story of life, reptiles were one of the first major players. For 180 million years they ruled the land, seas and skies - this was the rise of the giants.

programme.title: March (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: As northern forests become carpeted by bluebells and wood anemones, and damp corners become singles bars for frogs and a toads, hailing the first hint of spring sun, South Africa needs a break from the heat, fire season is in full swing, threatening the fynbos and the extraordinary animals living in them. Ground squirrels get inventive to find shade. Gray whales migrate up the Californian coast, passing colonies of sea otters. March is a month of change

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: Join us as we delve into the inner workings of the Two Oceans Aquarium and meet the team who keep the machine running! Learn how they cater for hundreds of different dietary requirements, how they keep up with the demand of life-giving water and meet the new arrivals to the aquarium; from the six-legged spider crabs of Japan, to the tiny turtles in need of rehabilitation. We'll move behind the glass to reveal the secrets of Africa's premier Aquarium!

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde meets one of Africa's most experienced elephant trackers: Hendrick Munembome, the Director of Elephant Human Relations Aid (EHRA). The struggle for water often makes elephants and humans rivals in Namibia. Therefore, EHRA builds water wells for the elephants with volunteers from all over the world, far away from the villages. Hannah helps dig a ditch for a pipeline, then heads up the dry Ugab riverbed in search of the endangered Mama Afrika' herd.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: The culture of Japan is incredible. But there are also more than 130 mammals and 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands.

programme.title: Forest High Life
programme.desc: Who doesn't love a peaceful, relaxing walk in the woods? A green bath in nature, one that some-times leads to exciting glimpses of wild animals going about their daily lives. But no matter how hard we look, we are missing the action; it goes right over our heads - literally! The leafy shade that makes forests so cool, shady and relaxing also hides a vast community head and shoulders above the rest. But this is the canopy, a habitat that holds the most wonderful animal diversity.

programme.title: Polar Bear Family
programme.desc: We have a complex relationship with polar bears. One of the most loved creatures in the world, we see them as cute and funny but at the same time as dangerous top predators. One of the few that might actually hunt us. They are the ultimate icons of polar wilderness and have become figureheads for climate change and conservation. One thing is for sure, the lives of polar bears are nothing short of remarkable.

programme.title: Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage. She's not the only newby as Nox the bushbaby, and new volunteers are around to keep her company.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: There are more Caribou in Alaska than people! Across the Arctic, they're the lifeblood of many remote communities. But human expansion, and wild predators, have led to their rapid decline. Out on the tundra, Caribou are the prey of choice for Alaska's carnivores, and at a ranch on the edge of Anchorage, the reindeer are at constant risk from the area's wolves and brown bears. The people of Anchorage have vowed to protect them, but will their help be enough for the Caribou to survive?

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Life in the Sea
programme.desc: Our planet is one of oceans, and it was this great mass of water that gave birth to Earth's greatest creation - life

programme.title: Wild Madagascar - Fantastic Creatures
programme.desc: Madagascar is located roughly 250 miles from Africa's Southeast Coast. It is roughly the size of France, making it the world's fourth largest island. Isolated from the African mainland for over 160 million years, more than 250,000 different species of animal can be found here; 70% of which are found nowhere else on the planet. Madagascar supports the third largest coral reef system in the world; the Toliara reef system.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: For years, at least four highly elusive wolfpacks have lived and hunted on the edge of the wild city of Anchorage. But as the city spreads further and further into wolf country, the wolves are now getting bolder, and attacks on humans are on the increase. A group was recently targeted whilst jogging with their dog on a trail near one of the city's main roads.

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a subcontinent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness.

programme.title: Hidden Germany
programme.desc: A dramatic country steeped in history and ancient culture, it's easy to focus on Germany's great cities and landmarks. But Germany also has a more hidden treasure-trove, one full of natural wonders

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Journey to the Land
programme.desc: As the first landmasses emerged from prehistoric seas, animals took their first steps on dry land. The explosion of life that followed changed the world forever.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde meets the most famous big cat researcher in the world. Dr. Laurie Marker is the founder of the Cheetah Conservation Fund (CCF), which has set the global benchmark for cheetah conservation. Hannah spends a day at the CCF center near Otjivarongo, gets very close to the big cats in the enclosure and is impressed by the simple, but effective concept of protecting these animals.

programme.title: Elephants - Changing Lives
programme.desc: Living for over half a century, elephants see the world change around them as they grow. They say an elephant never forgets; if we could enter the massive brain of a veteran elephant, what would we see? Imagine one elephant to represent them all, giving us a unique glimpse into the remarkable life of these magnificent giants.

programme.title: April (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: aster, a time of babies, easter eggs are everywhere as birds get busy breeding, lambs dance around fields and cute baby bunnies emerge from their borrows. Migrants like ospreys and puffins return to their breeding sites. Migrants can come in all shapes and sizes and for different reasons. Hammerhead sharks swarm around Galapagos and take advantage of cleaning services on the reef.

programme.title: Marine Mammals - Born to Swim
programme.desc: Every year some 15 million of us around the world cram onto little boats and head out onto the ocean, hoping for the encounter of a lifetime. For centuries whales and dolphins seem to have reached out to us, capturing our imaginations and our souls. Despite their popularity, much of their lives remain a mystery, taking place beneath the waves and beyond our reach.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Wildlife that inhabits mountainous regions has be able to survive successfully at high altitudes. Any creature that lives in the mountains must also be able to cope with changing temperatures. Many species of hoofed and herbivorous mammal such as GOATS, DEER, SHEEP AND LLAMAS have adapted well to living high in the mountains and are often found grazing on ledges and on cliff faces. These herbivores in turn attract large predators such as BEARS, COUGARS AND MOUNTAIN LIONS.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Islands come in all shapes and sizes all over the world. Any land mass surrounded by water is an island. They are found in seas, oceans lakes and rivers. Atolls, Islets, keys or cays are formed either as result of land brea-king away, water encroaching on the land, or by volcanic eruptions on the sea bed . Islands are often isolated, which leads to the development of a unique flora, fauna and wildlife. The environmental eco-structure of islands differs widely, as does the wildlife.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The Amazon. A magnificent broad-leafed rainforest. The heart of Brazil. The Amazon basin covers an impressive 7 million square kilometres. Rainforests are often known as the lungs of our planet. The Amazon Rainforest is the largest. Its value in terms of the Oxygen that it provides, and the Carbon Dioxide that it consumes is immeasurable. It is home to splendid, exquisite plant and animal species. The most diverse and numerous array of species found anywhere in the world.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Grasslands cover nearly fifty percent of the African continent. African grasslands support vast and diverse wildlife. Due to the open and uncovered nature of grassland, predators are much easier to spot, giving smaller animals a chance to run away, hide and survive. Thanks to the lack of hiding places for predators, the African savannah regions support a much greater diversity of wildlife than temperate grasslands.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's a miracle the first seafarers ever found the Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani scattered across two million square kilometres of the Pacific Ocean. But every year, these tropical islands become the destination for over three thousand Humpback whales who've undertaken one of the longest migrations on the planet. They come here to socialise, mate, and raise their young.

programme.title: The Power Of Plants - Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation - a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Rhino horn is very expensive in the illegal market and the poachers know it. Kaziranga has the only concentrated population of the one horned Rhino in the world. And poachers are attracted to Kaziranga like ants are to sugar. The primary work of the forest department here is to then protect the rhino from the poachers and save the horn. We meet forest guard Shanti Ram Chetri who after 33 years of glorious service retires.

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs. Most animals will defend themselves against predators, but many also do battle with members of the same species. Animals fight for two main reasons: for a mate or to defend their young or territory. And when animals fight, it can often be to the death.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Hunting has been a long-standing cultural tradition in the North Eastern India for long. But with the shirking of the forests and endangering of the wildlife, hunting has become unsustainable. But it is not that this has stopped hunting. The architects of Pakke, a 800 sq Kms forest reserve, in the heart of the hunting villages has done a wonderful job of giving protection to the several endemic species here by keeping the forest safe from the hunters.

programme.title: Animals of Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Thanksgiving. A most treasured holiday, and not just in the USA; it continues to be celebrated across the world in many different guises. These traditions are all united by a celebration of the harvest and the generosity of the natural world. Many animals have weird and wonderful connections to the holidays. Turkeys are one of the most iconic characters, but deer, lobsters and even eagles are also part of the feast.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying just off the coast of west Scotland, the Hebrides archipelago is made up of more than 500 islands and islets. Isolation from the mainland has made it the perfect breeding ground for millions of creatures, making it home to some of the largest gatherings, and greatest spectacles on the planet.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: The Royal Bengal Tiger is in it's most primeval form here in the Sunderbans. `The tangled mangroves along the tributaries of the river Ganga are one of the most fearsome forests of the World. The tigers could kill humans and eat them. The people living around the forests are also one of the poorest in the country. They have to go inside the forest to eke out a living by catching crabs and fish. And that's the opportunity the tiger may seek.

programme.title: Wild Indochinas - Wild heart
programme.desc: Indochina; three ancient kingdoms, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia, linked by one great river: the mighty Mekong. A mystical land shaped by the forces of the monsoon. A region ravaged by war but, like a Phoenix, risen from the ashes. Within its boundaries can be found one tenth of the world's species, and some of the richest ecosystems on the planet. This is the land of the Mother River, one of the most bio diverse regions on Earth.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Bred from wolves, Huskies have helped humans carve out an existence in Alaska's desolate wilderness. These dogs still maintain many physical adaptations of their wild ancestors, enabling them to withstand the fierce conditions of the Alaskan winter. And in Alaska's most extreme terrain, sled dogs are still the only form of transport. In the south, the modern city of Anchorage is still home to the start of the World's Toughest Race, a 1000 mile sled-dog race, known as the Iditarod.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: On the savannah of southern Africa, rains have turned the land green and lush. It's the time of plenty and for the cast of wild characters here, cashing in is priority number one. From polecat to aardwolf, some of the continent's most seldom seen creatures are out to make the most of the abundance. Some families gorge on the plentiful grasses, while for others there's no such thing as an easy meal, even at this time of year.

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving - but though always on the move they're not exactly speedy.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Deep in the Southern Ocean, the Snares islands are one of the most pristine island wildernesses left on the planet. Every summer, millions of seabirds converge here to breed. More than 50,000 endemic Snares crested penguins battle massive Southern Ocean swells to come ashore. Deep in the forest they find their mates and raise their chicks in a frantic race to take advantage of the short subantarctic summer.

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, heaviest, fastest, slowest - even the rarest. The creatures that hold the records for these categories are some of the most interesting in the natural world. Some are familiar and iconic, but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers. These quirky and unusual animals that often go ignored are inventive, ingenious and awe-inspiring.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: This episode explores nature's deadliest killers. From a tiny but deadly insect, to a pod of hungry Orca's, predators come in all sizes, and are found on every continent on earth. Chasing, stalking, ambushing or using camouflage, the way each predator hunts, catches and kills food is determined by many factors, including the anatomical adaptations of both the predator and the prey.

programme.title: Hidden UK
programme.desc: For its tiny size the UK is a hugely varied landscape with a surprising collection of remarkable and awe-inspiring wildlife.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to a huge number of wild porcupines, living in the city's parks, gardens and streets. Almost twice the average size, Anchorage's porcupines search for food here in the city, and find refuge during the bitter Alaskan winters. But life on the streets also takes its toll.Porcupines are the city's number one roadkill. In the wild, few animals other than wolves attempt to kill porcupines, and in the city, domesticated dogs can be as big a threat to the porcupines as wild wolves.

programme.title: Nature's Cutest
programme.desc: As we all know the natural world can be tough and challenging at times, but it can also be nothing short of adorable. Fluffy white seals, wobbly-kneed fawns, playing polar bear cubs, adorable teddy bear-like koalas - so much cute it would be impossible to decide which was the most adorable. But why do we consider some animals cute and others not? What it is about them that makes us fall in love? Perhaps it's those animals that remind us of ourselves?

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. programme.desc: Sheila Kirwan lives in Clonegal, Co.Carlow. Sheila lives with her husband Joe who is also a very good cook when needed. They grow a lot of their own produce, both fruit & veg, and like to attend the local farmer markets weekly in Enniscorthy.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Melbourne, Australia: Melbourne boasts a bunch of hard-living, good-natured, and eccentric food-lovers. In search of the outlaws of food, Tony explores a pasteurization-free cheese factory, and an old-world cured jamon workshop. Alas, no trip to Australia is complete without an authentic "barbie", so Bourdain settles down with new found friends for an afternoon meal of surf n' turf.
programme.sub-title: Down Under: The Wild West of Cooking

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, New York: Join Anthony Bourdain on his quest to characterize the perfect bar. With him, discover the importance of a "maniacal bartender", the proper chemical makeup of drinks, the joys of seedy dive-bars, and the need for late night snacks.

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim explore the relationship between spices and fats in three rich recipes. Juicy watermelon gets treated two ways: as a sauce and as a spicy pickle, both to top a caraway-infused Panna Cotta! Next, a lesson in infusing spice into compound butters: a zingy Za'atar and Lemon Butter for bread and a smoky Paprika and Bay Butter for Grilled Steak! Finally, flaky cod gets basted in juniper and rosemary butter before being sat on a bed of du puy lentils!

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Every cook needs to learn their Mother Sauces before they can claim the title of Chef. Spice Secrets co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim are no different, though their sauce recipes sure are! First, a traditional Tomato Sauce re-examined as a Bucatini All'Amatriciana spiced with Quatre Épices! Next, a rich veal Demi-Glace spiced two different ways, served with veal chops and Roasted Mushrooms! Finally, a spin on a classic Béarnaise Sauce, replacing tarragon with Aniseed.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares - Revisited

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Proper Pub Food

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Proper Pub Food
programme.desc: We all enjoy eating outdoors in a beer garden, and Tom wants to show us how to create outdoor food properly. Chicken in a basket with a twist, a tasty fish burger, a delicious maple cake, extra special barbecued beef ribs... it is chow time.

programme.title: Dine Your Sign
programme.desc: Chef Siobhan is all in for Virgo! She starts with some precious little parcels: spinach and potato knishes! The next dish is a comforting Celery Root Soup with pumpernickel croutons that references The Healer. Next, Virgos are brainy and fish is brain food, so Siobhan cooks up some fresh trout with a sweet-and-sticky orange-chili glaze. Finally, for something sweet, the most Virgo of all desserts: an aromatic, moist, and entrancing extra-virgin olive oil cake!

programme.title: Food Pop
programme.desc: There is nothing quite as addictive as French fries. While French fries generally refer to batonnet or allumette-cut fried potatoes. They come in all shapes and sizes. But what is it about French fries that makes them so popular? Is it their crispy...crunchy...texture? Their salty taste? Or is it the seemingly endless amounts of dipping sauces a French fry can be dunked in? Whatever the reason-French fries have solidified themselves as a go-to side dish...Or the perfect snack.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: After pulling a bank heist in Mexico, the outlaw Rio (Marlon Brando) and his partner, Dad Longworth (Karl Malden), make a run for it, but Dad has bigger plans than freedom. He betrays Rio and absconds with the loot, and Rio ends up in prison. Years pass before Rio finally breaks free to enact his long-plotted revenge. Tracking Dad to California, Rio learns he's become a sheriff -- which is no deterrent -- but when Rio falls for Dad's stepdaughter, Louisa (Pina Pellicer), he has second thoughts.

programme.desc: Ex-bounty hunter Talion (Robert Lansing) comes home one day to find his house ablaze and his entire family slaughtered. He soon learns that the culprits are a gang led by nasty Ike Slant (Slim Pickens). While tracking the outlaws, Talion meets fellow bounty hunter Benny (Pat Wayne), who's also after Ike. Initially mistrustful of each other, Benny and Talion are forced to work together when, during a shootout with the criminals, the latter is blinded and the former injures his shooting hand.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers want to get the most out of the driver. They demonstrate what the pros look like at impact and share what to do to get into that position.

programme.title: Me and My Golf

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward explain the big three in iron play: how to control distance, accuracy, and trajectory on shots. They also show a footwork drill to help ball striking and what to do to work the ball into those tucked pins.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward explain how to dial in distances with short irons and how to hit them on line every time; they also explain the bounce angle and how to choose the right amount.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers show how to play a variety of shots around the green, including the high spinning chip, low runner, and many more. They also explain the importance of focusing on a landing zone when hitting greenside shots.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers explain the necessary fundamentals to hit effective greenside and fairway bunker shots. They also explain how to hit it close from one of the most feared shots in the game, the 30-40-yard bunker shot.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Me and My Golf's Andy and Piers explain how to master judging speed and reads on the greens. They also demonstrate the proper mechanics for hitting it solid and making those clutch putts.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers explain how to master different lies on the course, featuring the buried lie, sitting up lie, and flyer lie.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers explain that the best play isn't always the hero shot. They demonstrate how save strokes by hitting over, under, and around trouble.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers explain how to save strokes by thinking around the course; they'll demonstrate how to take advantage of both sides of the tee-box and the importance of a good pre-shot routine.

programme.title: Golf Channel Academy
programme.desc: Rocco Mediate shares his best tips and unique drills. Rocco talks about how learning to top the ball on purpose can help you become a better ball striker.

programme.title: Golf Channel Academy
programme.desc: Rocco Mediate talks the short game and how you can master feel around the greens by using the bounce of your wedge.

programme.title: Golf Channel Academy
programme.desc: Jimmy Walker shares tips that helped him become a major champion, specializing on and around the green. Jimmy discusses the keys to greenside bunker play, teaches how to chip it close with the wedge, and reveals how an alignment rod helps sink putts.

programme.title: Golf Channel Academy
programme.desc: Jimmy Walker talks all aspects of distance, bringing out the driver to show how to gain distance off the tee and how to tone it down.

programme.title: Golf Channel Academy
programme.desc: Major champion Jimmy Walker breaks down all things full swing to show what has led him to multiple victories on the PGA TOUR. He highlights the trials, tribulations, and ultimately the rewards of implementing major swing changes.

programme.title: Golf Channel Academy

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Don Wilson
programme.desc: Don "the dragon" Wilson is considered one of the greatest kickboxers in the world. An 11-time World Kickboxing Champion in three weight classes, he has amassed a record of 82 fights with 72 wins and 48 by knockout. Inducted into the Martial Arts History Museum's Hall of Fame in 2001, Wilson was also entered into the Guinness Book of World Records. In 1982, he threw his hat into the acting arena and became one of the biggest icons in martial arts action films.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Eric Lee
programme.desc: Eric Lee is considered the pioneer of Chinese Kung Fu in the American Karate Tournament Circuit. Stepping into the area that was filled with all white gi's, Lee was the only Chinese Kung Fu competitor. Through his innovative style and expert Kung Fu ability, he quickly became the greatest competitors in the forms and weapons division. He was so impressive he was nicknamed "The King of Kata.

programme.title: Dragons Never Die
programme.desc: Li Tin Ming and his side kick, Hsiao San travel the countryside going from one martial arts school to the next challenging and defeating teacher and student alike to test his kung fu. The duo soon finds them in Hung An Town where a thug called 'The Leopard' rules over the people. Killing him, Li carries on his excursion to fight against all boxers. Along the way, he learns a lot about humility and the consequences of his actions.

programme.title: Three Avengers
programme.desc: When two acrobats are fired for fighting with punks in the audience, they go to live with an aunt who's being pressured to sell her house for a real estate development. The developer's nasty son, Lee Fu, decides to muscle the sale.

programme.title: Golden Mask
programme.desc: Life takes a strange and sinister turn for "killer for hire" Chi Kwan Chun after he accepts a contract from the mysterious "Golden Mask". The "mark" turns out to be Chi Kwan Chun's own brother and, after unwittingly fulfilling the contract, Chi keeps running into people who want to kill him for no apparent reason. Those that don't try to kill him seem to die themselves from poisoning.

programme.title: Big Family
programme.desc: Shek Kin plays the head of a large crime family. His sons get into all sorts of trouble with the other triad bosses. They escalate the situation with drugs, Kung Fu Tournaments and murder, creating a bitter feud with a rival family.

programme.title: 52 Masters

programme.title: 52 Masters

programme.desc: During the declining years of Ming dynasty, Mongolians sent secret agents to intrude central China and tried to obtain "The Light Sword" a mighty sword, which can gather all brave wanderers. programme.title: Ninja Knight 3: Heaven's Hell
programme.desc: After serving five years in prison for the murder of gang leader Donald's brother, Alfred, a fisherman by trade, finds that not only has his fiancée married into the mob but Donald is determined to ruin his life completely. A vendetta of mindless violence, which can only end in violent bloodshed.

programme.title: Monkey Fist Floating Snake

programme.title: Fearless Golden Dragon

programme.title: Mission for the Dragon

The brothers use their heads as well as their fists to find out why their father had to die.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru

programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 9

programme.sub-title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 6

programme.title: Bruce - Kung Fu Girls
programme.desc: Five pretty girls go to Hong Kong to stay with their uncle who is a police superintendent. Soon they run into a gang of thieves, which gives them a chance to put their excellent kung fu skills to good use. This Bod Squad will kick your ass!

programme.title: Mars Villa aka Wu Tang Magic Kick
programme.desc: John Liu and Phillip Ko star. Mar Tien Liang is the master of the Magic Kick. When his home is attacked by the Fang Kang he effortlessly defeats his opponent, but his wife Mar Tien Liang is horrified to witness such violence. She implores him never to use his magic kick again, and all is well, until Fang arrives to challenge the master.

programme.title: Boxers of Loyalty and Righteousness aka Shogun Saints
programme.desc: Warlord Yu Ming gain great power for himself. Anyone he suspects of disloyalty was jailed or murdered. He himself was a notorious killer having personally betrayed his friend General Yip and then slaughtered him and his family. But the General' son escaped and spent a lifetime to learn all the martial arts to take his revenge. He must lure Yu Ming away from his private army of thugs and gangster. Shogun warriors come to the ruler's defense, though a few of them have second thoughts.

programme.title: Dark Lady of Kung Fu

programme.title: Warriors of Budo

When Jigoro Kano turned the deadly Martial Art of Jujutsu into Judo, he created a global sport with competitors in more than two hundred countries. The Kodokan Judo institution is still however the symbolic beating heart of Judo.
programme.sub-title: Warriors of Budo Episode four: Judo

programme.title: Kung Fu Executioner

Unknown to Tony, the surviving gang member, he has a magical power which, if given the right training, will overcome Black Dragon and his sadistic vampiric tendencies.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub

programme.title: In the Mix
programme.desc: Mobster Frank (Chazz Palminteri) hires hip DJ Darrell (Usher) to man the turntables at a party for his gorgeous daughter, Dolly (Emmanuelle Chriqui). At the event, some crooks pull guns on the gangster, and Darrell steps in to save his life. Frank then gives the DJ a job as his daughter's bodyguard, but, to the mobster's dismay, Dolly starts to fall for the smooth-talking Darrell. Their romance is interrupted when Frank gets involved in a mob war and drags Darrell along with him.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Unable to pay back the $20,000 he owes the mob, small-time hustler Link (Antonio Fargas) instead gives up the identity of an undercover cop (Terry Carter) who happens to be dating his sister, Foxy Brown (Pam Grier). When gangsters later kill the cop, Foxy is quick to make the connection and swears vengeance. Posing as a prostitute, and with the help of a group of neighborhood vigilantes, she gradually tracks down the hit men, their Mafia bosses and her own brother.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail.

programme.title: The Forgiven
programme.desc: During his life sentence in post-apartheid South Africa, brutal murderer Piet Blomfeld seeks redemption through meetings with Archbishop Desmond Tutu.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.
A father hides his wife's drug addiction from his daughter.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: Who's Your Caddy?
programme.desc: Superstar rap mogul C-Note (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) wants to join the Carolina Pines Golf & Country Club, but faces stiff opposition from the establishment's snooty members. C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life.

programme.title: The Last Letter
programme.desc: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Delivery man Leo Jackson (Donald Faison) is definitely on the wrong road to success. He still lives at home, he and his girlfriend just broke up, and he has multiple complaints stacked against him at work. Fortunately, Leo has plenty of marijuana to keep his mind off his troubles. programme.title: Great Tank Battles

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: Germany, 1933. Adolf Hitler, at the head of the Nazi Party, has just become Chancellor and is faced with leading a republic in the throes of economic crisis and rampant inflation. Hitler used the cult of personality nurtured by his propaganda chief Joseph Goebbels, who spread the Nazis xenophobic and anti-Semitic ideology, which Hitler had been touting since the First World War.

programme.title: Blitzed: Nazis on Drugs
programme.desc: In 1938 a drug called Pervitin was created in Nazi Germany. This film explores the use of drugs in WW2 and looks at the potential effects that drugs could have had on Hitler, soldiers and the war itself.

programme.title: Nuclear Test Films

Some Jewish witnesses testified, and only Hans Frank, the Governor General of Poland, acknowledged the persecution of Jews.

programme.title: Blood Money - Inside the Soviet Economy

programme.desc: Summertime is dinner party season, and Lidia loves to serve family style meals. Today, she'll create a summer menu fit for any celebration. The menu includes grilled skewers of Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini and Tomato Salsa, steamed summery Green Beans with Mint Pesto and Berry Tiramisu - Lidia's summer berry twist one of the most famous Italian desserts!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasting enhances the flavor of any kind of meat and Lidia often makes a roast for family meals. Today's menu includes a Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon and Mushrooms; an easy and elegant Roasted Pork Loin with Cabbage and Dried Cherry Sauce; and Roasted Pear, Blueberry and Grape Compote for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich and six special guests at her holiday table: Christopher Walken, Rita Moreno, Ann Curry, Padma Lakshmi, Marcus Samuelsson, and Carlo Ponti, Jr. Hear the personal stories of each individual's journey to and in America, set against a backdrop in which they share a delicious meal that represents the diverse flavors that are part of celebrating the yuletide in New York.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Home for the Holidays

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be be made with all kinds seasonal fruits.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia talks about pasta in her family, it's never "basta!" Today, she creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a Linguine with Swisschard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta. She then makes a simple dish of Farfalle with Swordfish, prepared with tomatoes, fresh herbs and capers. And finally, there is nothing better than Lidia's Spaghetti and Meatballs!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.title: Eating In With Lidia
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shares the stories behind the great pantry-inspired recipes that her family has been eating for years--in both good times and challenging ones.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh herbs are simply a must in Lidia's kitchen and today she makes three dishes that highlight herbs AND spices. She begins the menu with Pickled Carrots: a quick pickle of tiny carrots packed with the flavors of parsley, garlic and mint; Braised Beef in Guazzetto: rich, braised beef filled with enticing aromas and Skillet Cauliflower with Lemon and Mint: cauliflower florettes showered with lemon juice and a sprinkle of fresh mint.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite desserts-one spoon dessert, one seasonal fruit based dessert and of course a baked sweet to warm up the kitchen. Her Limoncello Tiramisu is a sweet pick-me-up made with delicious limoncello zabaglione. Fruit is a natural as an Italian sweet to end a meal, and she loves to simply serve Grilled Fruit to magnify their natural sweetness. A favorite Italian cookie is the Chocolate Anise Biscotti, made with a shot of espresso.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The beautiful Adriatic Sea was a big part of Lidia's childhood, as she loved to play on the rocky beach and savor the bounty of the local waters. She prepares Linguine with Clams and Broccoli, a twist on the classic linguine con vongole. She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and with over 460 varieties made in Italy, it leads to many mouth-watering cheesy recipes. In this episode, Lidia shares her Cheese Baked in a Crust: gorgonzola wrapped with puff pastry and baked as crispy cheesy bites; Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad: a flavorful and fresh mix of celery, artichoke and mortadella; and finally Meatloaf Ricotta: a family favorite meatloaf dish packed with three different cheeses.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares recipes that are quick to whip up and ideal for days when you don't have much time to cook. She starts off by making Green Beans with Mint Pesto, a fresh alternative to the well-known green beans with butter. For a sweet treat, Lidia makes Chunky Cherry Bread Pudding, one of her favorite ways to recycle day-old bread. Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: From jumping the broom to tying the knot, wedding celebrations in America are as diverse as the nation itself, and Lidia cordially invites viewers to be her "plus one" on this cross-country matrimonial odyssey.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Weddings: Something Borrowed, Something New

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia makes pizza the centerpiece for your next party. With a variety of toppings, a salad and dessert, you are ready to go. ON the menu is a classic Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons; individual Pizzette with toppings like onion and cheese; chicken and mushroom; pear and gorgonzola and tomato & pecorino. While you have the dough, why not try a Dessert Pizza, topped with jams, Nutella, chocolate and fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pork guazzetto with beans; matalotta-style mixed fish stew.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The key to a delicious meal is coaxing a lot of flavor from an ingredient, whether it is meat or vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares two ragu recipes: Lamb and Pepper Ragu: and a Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu: a heart, flavorful medley of chestnuts and mushrooms that make for a satisfying vegetarian ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A cheese plate with plum mostarda and gnocco fritto; a platter of cheese with seasonal fruits and plum mostarda; fluffy fried bread served with prosciutto cotto; sausage and apples; risotto with orange juice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: "Alla Parmigiana" is a technique applied in many southern Italian dishes that is all about layering simple bold flavors.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried foods are not eaten often in Italy, but Lidia shares some recipes no one can resist. She makes Crispy Shrimp, a huge hit in her house that is sure to become a favorite in yours too; Crispy Baked Tomatoes, plum tomatoes topped with bread crumbs and baked in the oven until crispy; and finally, Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savoy Cabbage, an ideal main course for a hungry crowd.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are some restaurant favorites that can be cooked at home in this episode! Lidia prepares delicious Butternut Squash Gnocchi and a Pan Seared Halibut with Balsamic Reduction. Delizioso!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple in Lidia's kitchen and she loves planning dinner parties based on seafood. Today's menu includes Swordfish Skewers with a Sweet and Sour Sauce, made with balsamic vinegar and bay leaves; and Stuffed Calamari with bread crumbs, hard-boiled eggs, grated cheese, white wine, and parsley.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the Soup and Sandwhich concept shortly after she arrived in America. And soups are one of her favorite creations to make. In this episode, she prepares a velvety Spinach and ChickpeaSoup; an Italian style Baked Toast Sandwhich and to finish, she enjoys some oatmeal crepes with her grandson Ethan.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Salting your food is an important step in any kitchen, and the type of salt used can make a huge difference in your meal. Today's menu includes: Salted Cod Fritters: Crispy chunky cod fritters made for the perfect salty snack; Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce: an iconic Italian pasta dish with penne rigate in a creamy pink vodka sauce; Beef Chuck and Beer; a rick and flavorful braise that will beckon everyone to the table.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sweet and sour is a classic combination of flavors that can be found in almost every cuisine around the world, and in Italy it's called agrodolce and produces delicious, balanced dishes of savory and sweet.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement, even though she had to flee there to avoid the communist regime in her hometown of Pula. She and her family stayed with her Zia Nina, whose influence on Lidia's cooking is still seen in her recipes today. Recipes include Mussels Triestina, Orange & Raspberry Spritz, and a Coffee Panna Cotta made with a light, sweetened cream.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia as she shares holiday traditions with four families across America. From New York to San Antonio and San Francisco, celebrate Christmas, Passover, and Chinese New Year with Mo Rocca, Stanley Tucci, Ruth Reichl, and more!
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday Tables & Traditions

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When hosting an Italian-style cocktail party, all you need is some drinks, a nice selection of appetizers, and you're set! Back in the kitchen, Lidia creates a menu for the perfect cocktail party. She makes Mussels with Zucchini Salsa Verde, a small appetizer guests can slurp down while sipping on a cocktail. She then makes Bloody Mary, a classic cocktail everyone loves. Corn and apricots work wonderfully together, and Lidia ends with making Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves cooking for her family and today, she shares some of her favorite recipes to make for her grandkids, including a refreshing and kid-friendly Cherry Almond Spritzer; a simple dessert of Grilled Fruit, which brings out the fruit's natural sweetness; and Pasta Salad with Green Beans, Tomatoes and Mozzarella, a great dish for buffets, picnics, and large family gatherings.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Comfort food is loved in America, and today, Lidia shares comfort foods Italians love to make. Beef and Potato Goulash, made with sweet Hungarian paprika, is a great recipe for family gatherings. Salads are a favorite of Lidia's, and Country Salad is a welcomed addition to any buffet table. She ends on a sweet note with a luscious Hazelnut Parfait.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Family favorites are the topic in this episode. Lidia starts with a Penne "Al Brucio" made with a spicy tomato sauce, rosemary and a dollup of fresh ricotta. She also shares her famous chicken cacciatore recipe and talks about the best way to make garlic bread. For those looking for a refreshing drink, Lidia shares a delicious and fresh prosecco punch.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are so many varieties of cheese in Italy, and today's recipes feature some delicious ones. Lidia will make a Crostata with Mushrooms and Onion; A quick Salad and Chicken "Involtini" with Kale Pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dandelion and chickpea salad; one-pan chicken and aubergine Parmigiana.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta is a staple in any Italian home and today, Lidia prepares three pasta recipes that will become staples in your kitchen. The first dish on the menu is a quick Ziti with Kale Pesto and Crispy Bacon, a delicious way to recycle any kale pesto leftovers in the fridge. She then makes a delicious summertime pasta made with plum tomatoes, Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto, and finally Campanelle with Shrimp and Fennel, made with "little bells" that carry the chunky sauce so well.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Building the ultimate Italian cheeseboard; skilled sausage and peppers; St. Joseph's zeppole, fried dough filled with vanilla cream topped with Amarena cherries.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Striped bass with broccolini; roasted pepper and olive salad; tomato tart with pecorino Romano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up along the Adriatic sea so picnics at the beach were a common occurrence. Recipes in this episode include some seafood classics from the southern part of Italy including Orecchiette with Peas and Asparagus; Mussels with Farro, Cannellini and Chickpeas and a quick and delicious Chocolate Fig dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday for Heroes Season 1
programme.desc: In this moving special, acclaimed chef and food ambassador Lidia Bastianich pays homage to the men and women of our military and the truly life-saving sacrifices they make daily for our freedom. Lidia meets seven veterans, who share their incredibly inspiring stories.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday for Heroes

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Mushroom ragu; Moka coffee; Kaiserschmarrn, a light and fluffy eggy pancake topped with jam.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter panzanella; a mix of warm roasted vegetables tossed with bread and kale; crespelle bar; farina gnocchi.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rome is one of Lidia's favorite cities, and today's episode features some Roman classic techniques. Recipes include Scallops Saltimbocca and Seared Lamb Chops with Mint Salsa Verde and Roasted Potato Wedges.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia cooks up two Italian American favorites today in her kitchen- Lasagna with Ricotta and Fresh Mozzarella, baked to golden perfectionand Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks, pan fried and made with fresh tomato sauce and mozzarella. To round out the menu, she'll share a Perfect Simple Salad, traditionally eaten at the end of the meal in her Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: At the base of Italian cuisine are essential Italian ingredients and vinegar is one of them. Lidia masters the art of cooking with vinegar in this episode. She prepares a Red Cabbage and Bacon Salad in a warm bacon and balsamic vinegar dressing; Chicken in Vinegar Sauce; and a tangy garlic Savoy Cabbage and Potatoes dish.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia attended school near the beautiful city of Trieste before coming to America and picked up many essential skills from the nuns who ran it. Inspired by the soups she had for school lunches, she prepares a Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup, as well as a one pot meal of Sausages and Apples that can feed a hungry family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every cook dreams of a perfectly roasted chicken, and today Lidia shows the viewer how to do just that. She starts with an American favorite - a crunchy, cheese Caesar Salad. Her Lemon Roasted Chicken goes beyond comfort food with onions, rosemary and lots of lemons. Finally she prepares a free form Crostata with Juicy Plums.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Striped bass with broccolini; roasted pepper and olive salad; tomato tart with pecorino Romano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grandma Erminia's favorites grace today's menu and include a Rice & Pea Soup; a simple Prosciutto Cotto sandwich and a dish that the family finds on many Sunday menus: Baked Stuffed Shells.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Mussel bruschetta; a tasting of olive oil; spaghetti in lemon cream sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

Fried food always hits the spot and next on the menu is Fried Onion Rings, made Italian-style with Grana Padano cheese added to the batter for flavor and crunch; and finally, Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms is a rich dish that is perfect for colder months.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Eggs were always a favorite at Lidia's home as a kid and they still are. In this episode, she'll prepare Savory Egg Battered Zucchini Roll Ups; a refreshing and simple Fennel, Red Onion and Celery Salad topped with Italian Salami and a luscious Frittata Filled with Ricotta, Tomatoes, Onion and Basil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves entertaining and today, she shares recipes that are fit for any Italian dinner party. Bruschetta is a great party appetizer, and Lidia shares one of her favorite toppings: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta. Next on the menu is Beef and Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine, a hearty-one pol meal your guests will love.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia remembers some of her fondest childhood recipes that were made by her Grandmother Rosa in Italy. Recipes include Mussels Triestina and Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto. A fun and fruity Fruit Smash Soda is shared with her mother, Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Panzanella with fennel and shrimp; orange and tropea onion salad; green salad with apples and provolone; cabbage salad with speck.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Braising is a preferred technique in Lidia's kitchen and today she prepares one rich braised meat dish, along with two braised vegetable choices for the home cook. Recipes include: Beef Braised in Barolo; a Braised Kale with Bacon; and finally Braised Cauliflower.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
